_doc: TEMPLATE SPELL LIBRARY. Every voice-chantable ability in the game. Classes and characters reference spells by id. school must be one of PYROMANCY/CRYOMANCY/ELECTROMANCY/NATURE/HOLY/SHADOW/PHYSICAL. aliases are fuzzy voice-match keywords. manaRestorePct > 0 marks the free breath/attune discipline.

spells.name: Power Strike
spells.description: A swift, heavy blade strike.

spells.name: Flame Spark
spells.description: Hurls a searing burst of fire.

spells.name: Mending Touch
spells.description: Restores hit points to an ally.

spells.name: Aegis Guard
spells.description: Raises a defensive stance, reducing incoming damage.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Roaring sphere of flame.

spells.name: Frost Spike
spells.description: Piercing icicle.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Arcing lightning storm.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.description: Searing close-range flame slash.

spells.name: Arcane Barrier
spells.description: Absorbing vanguard protection.

spells.name: Thunder Cleave
spells.description: Sweeping lightning sword cleave.

spells.name: Temporal Stasis
spells.description: Acoustic distortion freezing a foe in time.

spells.name: Haste Cadence
spells.description: Rhythmic breath healing and quickening the party.

spells.name: Resonant Surge
spells.description: Multi-tonal acoustic shockwave.

spells.name: Shadow Spike
spells.description: Piercing needle from darkness.

spells.name: Void Drain
spells.description: Siphons life essence from enemy to caster.
spells.exampleChant: Void siphon drain their life essence!

spells.name: Umbral Veil
spells.description: Blinding smoke of dark matter.
spells.exampleChant: Veil of night consume the battlefield!

spells.name: Barcode Scan
spells.description: Rapid-fire optical scanner swipe across customer composure.

spells.name: Coupon Shield
spells.description: Cites expired date in fine print, parrying incoming aggression.

spells.name: Drawer Smash
spells.description: Violently shoves the steel cash drawer shut with a deafening clang.

spells.name: Price Check
spells.description: Pages overhead intercom for management verification.

spells.name: Box Cutter Slash
spells.description: Slices corrugated cardboard tape with swift utility blade.

spells.name: Cart Push
spells.description: Drives a train of nested shopping carts through congested aisles.

spells.name: Flatbed Charge
spells.description: Barrels a loaded iron U-boat flatbed cart forward.

spells.name: Pallet Crush
spells.description: Drops hydraulic forks with bone-rattling force.

spells.name: Shrink Wrap Hold
spells.description: Encases cargo in multi-layered industrial polyethylene film.

spells.name: Baler Grind
spells.description: Activates the 20-ton hydraulic baler ram with a groaning crunch.

spells.name: Warranty Pitch
spells.description: Traps customer in dense 3-year accidental protection clauses.

spells.name: Union Break
spells.description: Five minutes of breakroom coffee with the crew; you walk back out standing taller.
spells.exampleChant: Union break, coffee with the crew!

spells.name: Escalate
spells.description: Goes over their head: 'Let me get my supervisor on the line.'

spells.name: By the Book
spells.description: Recites the handbook, section and subsection, in a voice like a closing freezer door.

spells.name: Strength in Numbers
spells.description: The whole crew steps up behind you, and nobody in front of you can pretend you're alone.
spells.exampleChant: Strength in numbers, crew with me!

spells.name: Express Lane
spells.description: Flips on the express light and waves the whole line through at double speed.

spells.name: Flash Sale
spells.description: Announces a ten-minute flash sale three aisles away; the crowd stampedes off after it.

spells.name: Closing Pitch
spells.description: Corners the customer with the one closing line every specialist learns in their first week.
